name: EGLE Air Quality Division permit to install public notices and applications of interest
what: Read the current and past public comment notices for permits to install (Wayback copies for past years back to 2020) and the applications of interest pages, and list every gas or oil fired generator, turbine or engine permit of 50 MW or more, including data centers, campus and industrial plants.

name: EGLE MiEnviro Portal permits and documents
what: Use the harvested permit index in scopes/us-mi/work/permits/ from scopes/us-mi/harvest_permits.py. Read each plant's permits to install and Renewable Operating Permit for unit lists, megawatts, turbine make and model, and any new, replaced or removed units.

name: EGLE air sources that match no GEM plant
what: Answer every power or data center facility in scopes/us-mi/work/permits/_unmatched.md. For each, say whether it is a gas or oil generating plant of 50 MW or more that GEM lacks, a plant GEM has under another name, below the threshold, a data center for the watch list, or not a generating plant, with the permit as evidence.

name: Michigan Public Service Commission electronic dockets
what: Use batches/us-mi/harvest/psc_dockets.md from scopes/us-mi/harvest_psc.py, then search the docket site for anything it missed: the Consumers Energy plan (Case U-21090 and the plan filed in 2026), the DTE Electric plan (Case U-21193 and any newer filing), certificates of necessity, the Belle River conversion, the Monroe replacement, plant purchases, and data center contracts that name gas generation.

name: MISO generator interconnection queue
what: Use batches/us-mi/harvest/queues.md from pull_queues.py and list every gas or oil entry in Michigan, including entries whose state MISO has blanked but whose transmission owner is Michigan only, then chase each one to a primary document.

name: MISO Expedited Resource Addition Study (ERAS) entries
what: List every ERAS gas project in Michigan from the same queue data, with its owner and in-service date.

name: PJM interconnection queue, southwest Michigan
what: Use the PJM part of batches/us-mi/harvest/queues.md and list every gas or oil entry in Michigan, mainly in the Indiana Michigan Power area, then chase each one to a primary document.

name: EIA-860M newest monthly generator file
what: Read the Operating, Planned and Canceled or Postponed sheets for Michigan in the newest file, and account for every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more that GEM does not list.

name: EIA-860 annual survey, ownership and plant tables
what: Read the newest annual Ownership and Plant tables for Michigan to confirm owners, shares and street addresses of gas and oil plants, especially New Covert, Dearborn Industrial Generation and Midland Cogeneration Venture.

name: Consumers Energy news and plan pages
what: Read the news releases and the clean energy plan pages for gas plants that are announced, filed for approval, bought, expanded or being retired, including the two new gas plants in the 2026 plan and Karn units 3 and 4.

name: DTE Energy news and plan pages
what: Read the newsroom and the integrated resource plan pages for gas plants that are announced, under construction, converting or being retired, including Belle River, Monroe's replacement and plants tied to data center customers.

name: Wolverine Power Cooperative, Michigan Public Power Agency and Upper Peninsula utilities
what: Read the news pages of Wolverine Power Cooperative, the Michigan Public Power Agency, Lansing Board of Water and Light, Upper Michigan Energy Resources and UPPCO for new, converted or retired gas or oil generation, including engine plants.

name: Possible updates sheet, Michigan rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every Michigan row and answer each one in a record or a coverage note.

name: Data center campuses with on-site or dedicated gas generation
what: Find every Michigan data center campus announced since 2024, starting with the Saline Township campus served by DTE, and check each for on-site gas turbines, gas or diesel engine fleets (backup fleets included) or a utility gas plant built for it. A fleet whose summed electrical nameplate reaches 50 MW, or one with generators and no usable rating, is a new plant (briefs/_data_centers.md).
